faqs.question: Is my data or code sent to an external server when using Financial Calculators?

faqs.question: How does Financial Calculators handle large files or sensitive data?
faqs.answer: Because execution happens locally in your browser using modern Web APIs and V8 JavaScript engine optimizations, you get maximum privacy and low latency without network transfer limits.
